label: Expected improvement
subgoals: Standardize the gap between incumbent and posterior mean
Evaluate the normal distribution function and density there
Combine the mean term and the uncertainty term

label: Confidence bounds
subgoals: Multiply the posterior standard deviation by kappa
Subtract from the mean for a minimization problem
Run the candidate with the smallest bound

label: Comparing candidates
subgoals: Compute EI for each candidate against the same incumbent
Choose the candidate with the largest EI
Watch for small EI caused by an overconfident model
